gloss: to look down on, to despise

definitions.gloss: to look down on, to despise, to scorn
definitions.explanation: To regard someone or something as inferior; to treat with contempt.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}を{見下|みくだ}してはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't look down on people.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{他人|たにん}を{見下|みくだ}すような{態度|たいど}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: He has a condescending attitude toward others.

examples.japanese: {学歴|がくれき}で{人|ひと}を{見下|みくだ}すのは{間違|まちが}っている。
examples.english: It's wrong to look down on people based on their educational background.

notes:
A verb expressing contempt or condescension toward others.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}を{見下|みくだ}す (to look down on people)
- {見下|みくだ}すような{態度|たいど} (condescending attitude)
- {見下|みくだ}した{目|め}で{見|み}る (to look at with disdain)

RELATED TERMS:
- {見下|みお}ろす: to look down from above (physical)
- {軽蔑|けいべつ}する: to despise
- {蔑|さげす}む: to scorn
